subject: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813의 긴 문맥 구조와 에이전트 기술
central_claim: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is technically significant not merely because it exposes a one-million-token context window, but because its hybrid compressed attention, tool-call reasoning continuity and adjustable test-time compute form an integrated architecture for long-horizon agent work; this is a bounded E2 interpretation of DeepSeek's official report and API documentation, not an independently reproduced performance conclusion.

selection.reason: The release provides a concrete architecture for making million-token context useful in long-horizon agents: compressed and sparse memory, persistent reasoning across tool calls, and task-dependent reasoning effort. Official documentation and a public technical report make the mechanisms inspectable, while the article bounds benchmark and production claims to vendor evidence.

discovery_review.brief_source: editor-requested revision of the published special article

signals.note: The editor requested a rewrite centered on technical explanation, deep analysis and technological significance rather than version and pricing cautions.
Official GA announcement confirms the August 13 release and positions reasoning effort and agent integration as product changes.
The project-authored public report describes CSA, HCA, mHC, Muon, reasoning-effort training, interleaved thinking, agent evaluation conditions and reported efficiency measurements.
Official API guide confirms effort controls and the reasoning-content contract across tool calls.
Official model page confirms the 0813 service version, context/output limits and scheduled pricing.
Public project repository provides preview weights, implementation files and artifact metadata.

claims.claim: DeepSeek announced V4 Pro GA on August 13, 2026, and the official model page identifies the current service version as DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813.
claims.version: GA announcement and Models & Pricing page accessed 2026-08-14
claims.method: Read the official launch announcement and model details table.
limitations: Confirms the vendor's launch and version statement, not an independently pinned API endpoint.
conflict_of_interest: DeepSeek documentation is a vendor primary source.

claims.claim: DeepSeek-V4 combines Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention to reduce long-context compute and memory; the report measures V4 Pro at 27% of V3.2 single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of its KV cache at one million tokens.
claims.method: Read the abstract and architecture Sections 2.3.1-2.3.4, including the CSA/HCA design and reported V3.2 comparison.
limitations: The efficiency values are DeepSeek's model-internal measurements and were not independently reproduced in this article.
conflict_of_interest: The technical report is authored by DeepSeek-AI.

claims.claim: V4 uses mHC to constrain expanded residual mappings for signal stability and applies the Muon optimizer to most model modules while retaining AdamW for selected parameters.
claims.method: Read architecture Sections 2.2 and 2.4 describing doubly stochastic residual mappings and optimizer allocation.
limitations: The report's training-stability rationale is project evidence and is not a user-configurable API feature.
conflict_of_interest: The technical report is authored by DeepSeek-AI.

claims.claim: DeepSeek-V4 preserves reasoning state across tool-call rounds and exposes low, high and max reasoning effort; the report describes distinct specialist training configurations rather than a presentation-only length switch.
claims.version: Thinking Mode guide and arXiv:2606.19348v1 accessed 2026-08-14
claims.method: Read the API effort mapping and tool-call context rules, plus report Sections 5.1.1 and the Interleaved Thinking description.
limitations: Operational benefit depends on the agent runtime returning reasoning_content correctly and on workload-specific evaluation.
conflict_of_interest: Both sources are produced by DeepSeek.

claims.claim: The preview V4 Pro is described as a 1.6T-total, 49B-active MoE model pre-trained on more than 32T tokens.
claims.method: Read the report abstract and official preview announcement.
limitations: These are project-reported model and training figures for the preview artifact.
conflict_of_interest: Both sources are produced by DeepSeek.

claims.claim: The editorial significance is that compressed long-context memory, continued reasoning through tools and adjustable test-time compute form a coherent design for long-horizon agents.
claims.version: Derived from C2-C5 using sources accessed 2026-08-14
claims.method: Derived a bounded architectural interpretation by connecting the report's attention design, agent context management and reasoning-effort training with the GA API surface.
limitations: This is an editorial interpretation of the design direction, not an independently measured claim that V4 Pro wins across all agent runtimes.
conflict_of_interest: The source bundle is primarily DeepSeek/project material; no independent benchmark was run.
